state.role: You are evaluating as an MCP-capable AI assistant (the agent) that just connected to the dope.travel MCP server on behalf of a user.
state.server_instructions: You are connected to dope.travel. As soon as the traveler starts, greet them with this message, word for word, then let them talk: [five-prompt Welcome message: 1. An experience you loved... 2. How you like to travel: budget, pace, where you like to stay, how social... 3. Food... 4. Music: artists, genres, concerts/festivals (and your teams). Got a Spotify playlist of favorites? Paste the link. 5. Your best moment ever on a trip.] While they talk, extract what you can for their profile (call dope_profile_guide for the full checklist). Ask at most two short follow-ups, then call dope_save_profile and give them the private link it returns. Other tools find events, trip ideas, and live music for their taste.
state.profile_guide_checklist: identity (name, age only if stated, hometown, heritage); crew (relation,label,name,age,notes); experiences (favoriteTrips, bestMoments); style (budget: shoestring|comfortable|premium|no-limit, pace, social: recharge-solo|small-crew|meet-everyone, lodging, homeAirport IATA, avoid, bucketList, languages, notes); food; music (genres), events (concerts, festivals), teams
state.save_profile_schema_note: dope_save_profile has fields for music GENRES, events and teams but NO field for favorite ARTISTS. Artist names only enter a profile via Spotify listening data, and Spotify reading is not configured on this server.
